description: The pre-trade check in one call for a Robinhood Chain token: clear (no rule-based blocker) or the blockers and warnings, each named, with the readings behind them — the verdict with its reasons, the deployer's record, holder concentration, the market, the measured X callers who named the token (coordinated clusters count once), the contract template. Free under a daily per-IP cap of 100, $0.02 over x402 past it, every plan key covers it. Rule-based observations, never a recommendation.
name: robinx_check
